import subprocess
import tempfile
root=Path.cwd()

                        "--output",str(work)],check=True)

            "evidence/audit/audit-source-verification.json","evidence/audit/audit-build-log-excerpts.txt"]
    for check in checks:
        assert (work/check).read_bytes()==(root/check).read_bytes(),check

        assert required in report,required
